items.title: 〈陸股盤後〉三大指數「V轉」收紅 滬指守穩三千九大關 惟周線仍跌0.3%
items.title_en: Mainland Stocks Close Higher as Three Major Indices 'V-Shaped' Recovery
paras: 中國A股三大指數今(14)日齊步收紅，上證指數(SSEC)全天狹幅震盪，終場小漲收於平盤，但本周仍收低0.3%。
滬指今日收紅0.01%至3927.18點，深證成指(SZI)收高0.45%至14354.31點，創業板指收漲1.12%至3626.3點，滬深兩市成交額成交額人民幣2.14兆元，較上一交易日量縮4081億元。
盤面上，通訊設備族群領漲兩市，共進股份、亨通光電等多股漲停，阿萊德、長盈通、共通股、大唐電信、劍橋科技等多股亦漲停或漲超10%；稀土、CPO類股開高走高表現強勢，中國稀土、華宏科技、資料港、網宿科技漲停；能源設備、煤炭、電子零件等族群也漲幅居前。
下跌族群方面，電力股集體表現低迷，華銀電力、梅雁吉祥、粵電力A、華電遼能、京能電力等跌超8%；醫藥生物族群衝高回落，美諾華、超研股份等跌超7%，萬邦醫藥、瑞康醫藥、南模生物、百花藥、南模生物、百花藥等跌逾3%；文化傳媒、港口、券商族群跌幅居前
根據Wind統計數據，滬深兩市及北交所共2398檔股票上漲，2963檔下跌，平盤173檔。另據大智慧VIP，滬深北三市共90檔股票漲幅在9%以上，25檔股票跌幅在9%以上。
中信證券表示，中國央行今年第二季貨幣政策報告對中國經濟定調「穩定運行、向新向優」，國際方面強調對地緣風險和AI發展的關注。貨幣政策層面要求「綜合運用並適時調整貨幣政策工具」，定調略偏積極。流動性方面，中國央行要求引導短端資金利率圍繞政策利率運行，而降成本層面則提及推動貸款定價基準多元化，央行下一階段可能繼續加大金融對於實體經濟的支持。
興業證券則說，目前A股市場景氣邏輯正在回歸，基本面成為重要的定價線索。具體來看，淨利潤、營收與訂單增速等景氣因素成為近期市場的「分水嶺」，並成為多數行業的主要定價因子，基本面仍是交易核心。

渤海證券指出，市場信心正進入重建過程，兩融現已穩定回升跡象。不過，半年報業績密集揭露期的到來，令部分資金短期轉為觀望，市場成交也出現縮量。伴隨反彈持續，行情透過震盪進行籌碼交換的需求正在上升。站在中期視角來看，經濟向新向優的格局已形成，政策端也在加力推動這一方向轉變，管理層「提升資本市場韌性和信心」的政策部署，使得股市的中期方向得以明確，投資者應利用半年報及業績預期的增量變化，積極進行配置調整，完成對中期行情的佈局。
光大證券策略首席分析師張宇生認為，8月半年報密集揭露期可望成為市場從「估值消化」切換至「獲利驅動」的轉折點，也許是今年下半年較好的配置窗口。當前中國國內外科技企業獲利均維持高成長，同時整體獲利成長率也在PPI的帶動下持續回升，A股非金融企業今年上半年獲利成長率可望達15%左右，加上政策層面的系統性支持，以及A股對海外衝擊敏感度續降，8月半年報季節或是下半年較好的配置窗口。
paras_en: China's A-share three major indices closed higher on Thursday, with the Shanghai Composite Index (SSEC) experiencing a narrow range of fluctuations throughout the day, ending slightly higher at the close, but still down 0.3% for the week.

The Shanghai Composite Index closed 0.01% higher at 3,927.18, while the Shenzhen Component Index (SZI) closed 0.45% higher at 14,354.31, and the ChiNext Index closed 1.12% higher at 3,626.3. The combined turnover of the two markets was 214 trillion yuan, down 40.81 billion yuan from the previous trading day.

On the trading floor, the telecommunications equipment sector led the gains in both markets, with shares such as Zhongchuang Shares, Hengtong Optoelectronics, and others hitting the daily limit. Other shares such as Aled, Changping, Zhongtong, Datang Telecom, and JCB Technology also hit the daily limit or rose over 10%. Rare earth, CPO, and other stocks also performed strongly.

The decline in the power sector was led by stocks such as Huaan Power, Meiyang Jixiang, Yue Power A, Hua Deng Liaoning, and Jinyang Power, which fell over 8%. The pharmaceutical and biotechnology sector also fell, with stocks such as Meinova, Chuyuan Shares, and others falling over 7%. The cultural media, port, and securities sectors also fell.

According to Wind data, 2,398 stocks in the Shanghai and Shenzhen markets rose, while 2,963 fell, and 173 remained unchanged. According to Big Intelligent VIP, 90 stocks in the three markets rose over 9%, while 25 fell over 9%.

China Securities said that the People's Bank of China's second-quarter monetary policy report has set a stable and optimistic tone for China's economy, with a focus on the development of AI and geographical risks. The report also emphasized the need to use monetary policy tools comprehensively and adjust them as needed. In terms of liquidity, the central bank requires short-term interest rates to be around the policy rate, while on the cost side, it proposes to promote the diversification of loan pricing benchmarks.

Xingye Securities said that the market's sentiment logic is returning to normal, and the fundamental factors have become the most important pricing indicators. Specifically, net profit, revenue, and order growth have become the key factors in the market's 'watershed', and have become the main pricing factors for most industries. The fundamental factors are still the core of the transaction.

Bohai Securities pointed out that market confidence is entering a rebuilding process, with the two-way market already showing signs of stability. However, the upcoming half-year report season has led to a short-term shift in some funds to a wait-and-see attitude, resulting in a decrease in market turnover. As the rebound continues, the demand for stock exchange is increasing. From a medium-term perspective, the economic structure has shifted towards new and better growth, and the policy side is also pushing this direction. The management layer's policy deployment to 'improve the resilience and confidence of the capital market' has made it clear that the medium-term direction of the stock market, and investors should actively adjust their allocations and complete their medium-term layout based on the changes in half-year reports and earnings expectations.

Guangda Securities' chief strategist, Zhang Yusheng, believes that the August half-year report season may become a turning point for the market to switch from 'valuation digestion' to 'profit-driven', and may be a better configuration window for the second half of the year. Currently, China's domestic and foreign technology companies have maintained high growth in profits, and the overall profit growth rate has continued to rise under the driving of PPI. The A-share non-financial companies' profit growth rate may reach around 15% in the first half of the year, plus the systematic support from the policy side, and the A-share's sensitivity to overseas shocks continues to decline, the August half-year report season may be a better configuration window for the second half of the year.

items.title: 日銀傳最快9月升息 並考慮加速緊縮節奏以抑制通膨風險
items.title_en: BOJ May Hike Rates as Soon as September, Consider Accelerating Tightening to Contain Inflation Risk
paras: 根據《路透》引述知情人士報導，日本央行(BOJ)最快可能在今年 9 月 17 日至 18 日的政策會議上調升利率，並正考慮在未來採取比目前每年兩次更為激進的升息節奏。
此舉反映出日本央行對通膨超預期的警覺性日益增強，尤其關注中東衝突、全球人工智慧需求強勁以及日元持續疲軟所帶來的物價壓力。
消息人士指出，「早期升息已進入視線」，顯示 9 月升息的可能性極大。
儘管日、美兩國上個月罕見地聯合干預匯市，但日元貶值趨勢依然推升了進口成本。此外，日本 7 月的批發通膨仍維持在3年高位，且調查顯示家庭、企業與經濟學家的通膨預期均已接近或超過 2% 的目標，顯示物價壓力正擴散至消費端。
日本央行總裁植田和男先前表示，若金融環境過於寬鬆，央行可能會加速升息，並將委員會對通膨風險的擔憂納入未來決策考量。目前市場預測 9 月升息的機率已接近 80%。
部分分析師認為，若 9 月如期升息，將為 12 月再次調升打開空間，這意味著日本央行的升息頻率可能轉變為大約每季一次，以避免在通膨曲線中落後。
paras_en: According to a Reuters report citing informed sources, the Bank of Japan (BOJ) may raise interest rates as early as September 17-18 policy meeting, and is considering adopting a more aggressive interest rate hike schedule than its current twice-a-year pace.

This move reflects the BOJ's growing awareness of the risk of inflation exceeding expectations, particularly in the face of the Middle East conflict, strong global demand for artificial intelligence, and the yen's persistent weakness, which has put upward pressure on prices.
Sources say that 'early rate hikes are now in sight,' indicating a high likelihood of a September rate hike.

Despite the rare joint intervention by Japan and the US last month, the yen's depreciation trend has continued to push up import costs. Additionally, Japan's wholesale inflation in July remained at a three-year high, and surveys showed that households, businesses, and economists' inflation expectations have approached or exceeded the 2% target, indicating that price pressures are spreading to the consumption side.

BOJ Governor Haruhiko Kuroda has previously stated that if the financial environment becomes too loose, the BOJ may accelerate rate hikes and take into account the committee's concerns about inflation risk in future decision-making. The market currently predicts a 9 September rate hike with a probability of nearly 80%.

Some analysts believe that if a 9 September rate hike occurs as scheduled, it will open up space for another rate hike in December, implying that the BOJ's interest rate hike frequency may shift to approximately once a quarter to avoid falling behind in the inflation curve.

items.title: 營收上看5000億美元！馬斯克再發豪語： 2027年底xAI資料中心供電容量衝上10GW
items.title_en: Revenue to Look at $50 Billion! Musk Again Makes a Bold Statement: 10GW AI Data Center Power Capacity to Reach 10GW by End of 2027
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，全球首富馬斯克在SpaceX員工會議上透露，旗下 SpaceXAI(原xAI)資料中心電力容量預計明年底前擴大約 7倍，達到10GW，較目前孟菲斯與南海文(Southaven)兩處合計1.4GW暴增逾 6 倍，相當於約1.5 年內完成此一躍進。
美國科技媒體《Tom's Hardware》週四(13日)報導指出，馬斯克在員工大會上宣稱，SpaceXAI已建成「全球最強AI訓練聚落」，並打算明年底前將其規模擴至當前約10 倍。
根據馬斯克估算，若每瓦價值約30至50美元且10GW AI 算力如期上線，xAI每年可創造3000億至5000億美元收入。
不過，業界提醒，資料中心以GW描述供電容量不等於實際算力，冷卻、照明、供配電、網路、儲存與伺服器等系統均會消耗電力，實際可用於運算的比例需視整體基礎設施效率而定。
分析人士指出，馬斯克的擴張藍圖若成真，將使xAI躍居全球AI基礎設施頂尖行列，但也代表著龐大的資本支出與能源挑戰。10GW供電規模約等同於多座大型核電廠的輸出，電力取得、散熱技術與供應鏈排程將是決定這項野心能否落地的關鍵變數，市場後續將密切關注其融資動向與實際建置進度。
paras_en: According to the latest reports from foreign media, the world's richest man, Musk, revealed at a SpaceX employee conference that the power capacity of the SpaceX AI (formerly xAI) data center is expected to expand by approximately 7 times by the end of next year, reaching 10GW, which is more than 6 times the current combined capacity of Memphis and Southaven, equivalent to completing this leap in about 1.5 years.

US tech media Tom's Hardware reported on Thursday (13th) that Musk claimed at the employee conference that SpaceX AI has built the 'world's strongest AI training cluster' and plans to expand its scale to about 10 times the current scale by the end of next year.

According to Musk's estimate, if each watt is valued at around $30 to $50 and the 10GW AI computing power is put into operation as scheduled, xAI can generate $30 billion to $50 billion in revenue per year.

However, the industry reminds that describing the power capacity of the data center in GW does not equal the actual computing power, and the cooling, lighting, power distribution, network, storage, and server systems will all consume electricity, and the actual usable proportion for computation needs to be determined by the overall infrastructure efficiency.

Analysts point out that if Musk's expansion plan comes true, xAI will become the world's leading AI infrastructure, but it also represents a massive capital expenditure and energy challenge. The 10GW power scale is equivalent to the output of multiple large nuclear power plants, and the acquisition of power, heat dissipation technology, and supply chain scheduling will be the key variables that determine whether this ambitious plan can be implemented, and the market will closely follow its financing trends and actual construction progress.

items.title: AI浪潮與內需發力 馬來西亞年第二季經濟成長6% 超乎預期
items.title_en: AI Wave and Domestic Demand Drive Malaysia's Q2 2026 Economic Growth to 6% Exceeding Expectations
paras: 馬來西亞國家銀行(BNM)與統計局周五(14日)公布，受惠於人工智慧(AI)熱潮帶動的出口激增以及穩健的國內需求，馬來西亞 2026 年第二季國內生產總值(GDP)年增長率達到 6%。這一數字不僅高於先前初步預估的 5.8%，也超越了市場普遍預期。
數據顯示，第二季的強勁增長主要歸功於電子與電氣(E&E)產品出口的復甦。隨著全球對 AI 技術需求激增，半導體等關鍵組件的出口成為推動經濟的重要動能。此外，液化天然氣(LNG)及非 E&E 製造業的出口回升，進一步支撐了貿易表現。
在國內方面，受惠於穩定的就業市場與收入成長，家庭支出保持強勁。同時，私人與公共領域在建築、機械與設備方面的持續投入，也帶動了投資增長。
馬來西亞國家銀行總裁Abdul Rasheed Ghaffour指出，儘管外部環境多變，大馬經濟仍處於堅實基礎上，2026 年上半年整體成長已達 5.7%。
在物價方面，第二季整體通膨率從首季的 1.6% 微升至 1.9%，主因是中東衝突推升了 RON97 汽油與柴油的外部成本壓力。然而，核心通膨率則從 2.1% 放緩至 1.9%。Abdul Rasheed強調，政府採取的針對性燃料補貼與穩定的需求，有助於限制全球成本波動對國內物價的傳導。
在匯率上，令吉表現相對穩定，在數據公布後維持在 4.09 兌 1 美元左右。相較之下，印尼盾與菲律賓披索近期均曾觸及歷史低點，顯示投資者對大馬經濟前景及結構性改革充滿信心。
在產業表現上，礦業與採石業受惠於天然氣增產轉為正成長，但農業則萎縮 3.7%，主因是油棕產量在去年高峰後回歸正常化。
展望未來，國家銀行將 2026 全年經濟成長預測維持在 4% 至 5% 之間，並樂觀表示最終成長可能接近 5% 甚至更高。大華銀行(UOB)更已將其全年預測調高至 5.1%。
儘管中東局勢升級、航運中斷或聖嬰現象(El Niño)可能帶來下行風險，但大馬政府已準備好透過 SME 穩定緩解機制(SME Stabilisation Relief Facility)等政策，支持受影響的企業與中小企業，確保經濟持續穩健成長。
paras_en: Malaysia's central bank (BNM) and statistics bureau announced on Friday the 14th that, buoyed by a surge in exports driven by the artificial intelligence (AI) boom and solid domestic demand, Malaysia's gross domestic product (GDP) grew at an annualised 6% in the second quarter of 2026. This figure is not only higher than the earlier preliminary estimate of 5.8% but also surpasses the market consensus.

The data show that the strong Q2 growth was mainly due to a rebound in electronic and electrical (E&E) product exports. With global demand for AI technologies soaring, exports of key components such as semiconductors became a major engine of the economy. In addition, exports of liquefied natural gas (LNG) and non‑E&E manufactured goods also recovered, further supporting trade performance.

Domestically, stable employment and rising incomes kept household spending robust. At the same time, continued private and public investment in construction, machinery and equipment drove up overall investment.

Bank Negara Malaysia Governor Abdul Rasheed Ghaffour said that despite a volatile external environment, the Malaysian economy remains on a solid footing, with overall growth in the first half of 2026 already at 5.7%.

On the price side, overall inflation in the quarter edged up from 1.6% in the first quarter to 1.9%, mainly because Middle‑East conflicts lifted external cost pressures on RON97 gasoline and diesel. Core inflation, however, slowed from 2.1% to 1.9%. Abdul Rasheed stressed that targeted fuel subsidies and stable demand have helped limit the transmission of global cost volatility to domestic prices.

The ringgit remained relatively stable, staying around 4.09 to the US dollar after the data release. By contrast, the Indonesian rupiah and Philippine peso both recently touched historic lows, reflecting investor confidence in Malaysia’s economic outlook and structural reforms.

In terms of sector performance, mining and quarrying benefited from higher gas production and turned positive, while agriculture contracted 3.7%, mainly because oil‑palm output returned to normal after last year’s peak.

Looking ahead, the central bank keeps its 2026 full‑year growth forecast between 4% and 5% and is optimistic that the final figure could approach 5% or even higher. United Overseas Bank (UOB) has already raised its annual forecast to 5.1%.

Despite potential downside risks from escalating Middle‑East tensions, shipping disruptions or an El Niño event, the Malaysian government is ready to support affected firms and SMEs through measures such as the SME Stabilisation Relief Facility, ensuring continued steady growth.

items.title: 〈台幣〉一度升破32元大關 收32.046元 強升1.22角
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar Briefly Broke the 32‑Per‑Dollar Barrier, Closing at 32.046, a Strong Rise of 1.22 Cents
paras: 新台幣今(14)日再度呈現強升格局，全日處升值態勢，更一度升破32元大關，終場收在32.046元，升值1.22角，台北外匯經紀公司成交值擴大至22.28億美元。
新台幣今日以32.15元、升值1.8分開出後，最高來到31.991元，全日高低價差1.59元。
觀察主要亞幣，新台幣收升0.38%，韓元也升值逾0.3%，日元升近0.2%，人民幣、星元小升約0.05%上下，泰銖則小貶0.05%。
統一投顧表示，美國 7 月 CPI 月增 0.1%，符合市場預期，而核心PPI 月增 0.2%，則低於市場預期的 0.3%，進一步緩解市場對聯準會 9 月升息的擔憂。
元大投顧則指出，美國 7 月非農就業人口意外下滑，且最新 CPI 數據如常，使市場擔憂升息程度減輕不少，預期 8 月底全球央行年會前聯準會不至於出現過於鷹派的言論。
paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar again showed a strong upward trend today (the 14th), staying in appreciation mode throughout the day and at one point breaking the 32‑per‑dollar mark, ultimately closing at 32.046, a gain of 1.22 cents, with the Taipei foreign‑exchange brokerage’s transaction volume expanding to US$2.228 billion.
The New Taiwan dollar opened at 32.15, up 0.18 cents, and rose to a high of 31.991 during the session, with a daily price range of 1.59 cents.

Among the major Asian currencies, the New Taiwan dollar closed up 0.38%, the Korean won also appreciated by more than 0.3%, the Japanese yen rose nearly 0.2%, the Chinese yuan and Singapore dollar each inched up about 0.05%, while the Thai baht slipped about 0.05%.

Unified Investment Advisory noted that U.S. CPI for July rose 0.1% month‑over‑month, in line with market expectations, while core PPI rose 0.2% month‑over‑month, below the expected 0.3%, further easing concerns about a September rate hike by the Federal Reserve.

Yuanta Investment Advisory pointed out that U.S. non‑farm payrolls unexpectedly fell in July and the latest CPI data came in as expected, reducing market worries about the extent of future rate hikes, and they anticipate that the Fed is unlikely to adopt an overly hawkish tone before the global central‑bank meetings at the end of August.

items.title: 干預越多、空頭笑越大聲！高盛：日本15年來最大干預引發日元套利部位大幅平倉
items.title_en: Intervention Fuels Short Selling as Goldman Sachs Sees Largest Intervention in 15 Years
paras: 高盛週五(14日)出具研究報告指出，日本15年來最大規模的外匯干預，非但沒能扭轉日元頹勢，反而替市場「創造了更高價位拋售日元」的戰術窗口。
美日兩國上月底罕見聯手買入日元，一度將美元兌日元從逼近163拉回155附近，但不到兩週便再度滑向160大關，今日日圓兌美元在亞洲匯市早盤報159.46。
高盛策略師Karen Reichgott Fishman表示，此次干預引發的戰術性日元套利平倉規模，已超過2024年7月那輪干預後的初期平倉量。若宏觀環境轉向支撐日元，部位甚至可能翻為淨多頭，重演2024年夏天的劇本，但當前日美利差仍大，日本利率僅約1%，遠低於多數發達經濟體，借低利日元、買高息資產的套利交易利潤空間依舊誘人。
另據摩根大通與道富數據，截至8月4日，避險基金已砍掉一半看空日元押注，但部分資金正回流套利池。
Alpha Binwani Capital創辦人Ashwin Binwani說：「干預給了我們在更好價位賣日元的絕佳機會，套利交易太香了，不能錯過。」
道富東京分行經理Bart Wakabayashi也表示，實錢帳戶仍保留套利持倉，日元兌澳元、歐元、美元、加元、英鎊皆被持續賣出。今年做空日元兌哥倫比亞比索、土耳其里拉、挪威克朗的組合報酬率均超過10%。
當前風險在於，空頭回補越積越多，官方再度出手機率同步攀升。過去一週日元已吐回干預帶來的一半左右升幅，財政壓力與利差因素未消除前，160關卡仍是市場與東京當局的敏感紅線。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs released a research report on Friday (14th) stating that Japan's largest foreign exchange intervention in 15 years has not only failed to reverse the yen's decline, but has instead created a higher price point for selling yen.

The US and Japan jointly purchased yen at the end of last month, temporarily pushing the dollar-yen exchange rate from near 163 to around 155, but it slid back to the 160 level in less than two weeks. The yen-dollar exchange rate in Asian markets opened at 159.46 today.

Goldman Sachs strategist Karen Reichgott Fishman stated that the tactical yen short selling scale triggered by this intervention has exceeded the initial scale of short selling after the intervention in July 2024. If the macro environment turns to support the yen, the position may even turn into a net long position, replaying the script from the summer of 2024, but the current US-Japan interest rate difference is still large, and Japan's interest rate is only around 1%, far lower than most developed economies, making the low-yen, high-yield asset trading profit space still attractive.
According to data from Morgan Stanley and UBS, as of August 4, hedge funds have cut their yen short selling bets by half, but some funds are returning to the arbitrage pool.
Alpha Binwani Capital founder Ashwin Binwani said, 'The intervention gave us an excellent opportunity to sell yen at a better price, and the arbitrage trading is too tempting to miss.'

UBS Tokyo branch manager Bart Wakabayashi also stated that real money accounts still hold arbitrage positions, and yen against Australian dollar, euro, US dollar, Canadian dollar, and British pound are being continuously sold. The return on investment for short selling yen against Colombian peso, Turkish lira, and Norwegian krone this year has all exceeded 10%.

The current risk is that the short selling rebound will accumulate more and more, and the official intervention will increase in probability. The yen has already recovered about half of the upward momentum brought by the intervention in the past week, and the fiscal pressure and interest rate factors have not been eliminated, so the 160 level is still a sensitive red line for the market and the Tokyo authorities.

儘管通膨壓力近期有所緩解，但委員會認為仍需維持緊縮的貨幣政策，以確保通膨能在合理時間內回落至目標水準。
挪威央行總裁巴克(Ida Wolden Bache)在聲明中指出，今年夏季的通膨數據低於預期，這是一個令人欣慰的消息，但目前的通膨率依然過高。她強調，現在得出通膨前景已發生實質性變化的結論還為時過早，因此「未來仍有必要提高政策利率」。
雖然挪威近兩個月的核心物價增長出人意料地溫和，讓官員有空間觀察這座能源資源豐富的經濟體是否正在降溫，但推動國內物價的關鍵因素——包括強勁的薪資增長與緊繃的勞動力市場——依然穩固。此外，央行特別提到，中東地區的持續衝突也為全球通膨前景增加了不確定性。
在利率決議公布後，挪威克朗兌歐元匯率小幅走弱 0.2% 至 10.9684。分析師對於 9 月是否會進行最後一次升息看法分歧。丹麥銀行(Danske Bank)首席經濟學家 Jullum 認為，8 月的核心通膨可能再次攀升至 3% 以上，這將迫使央行在 9 月採取行動，儘管這將是一個「艱難的抉擇」。目前交易員預計 9 月升息的可能性已從先前的預期略微下修。
挪威央行預計將在 9 月發布新的通膨預測與政策路徑報告，屆時將提供更多關於利率走向的明確指引。
paras_en: The Norwegian central bank announced on Thursday (13th) that it would maintain the benchmark interest rate at 4.25% unchanged, a decision that fully met market expectations, with all 16 analysts surveyed by the media accurately predicting the outcome.

Although inflationary pressures have eased in recent periods, the committee believes that it is still necessary to maintain a tight monetary policy to ensure that inflation returns to its target level in a reasonable time.

Norwegian Central Bank Governor Ida Wolden Bache stated in a statement that the summer inflation data were lower than expected, which is a welcome news, but the current inflation rate is still too high. She emphasized that it is too early to conclude that the inflation outlook has undergone a substantial change, and therefore, "it is still necessary to raise policy interest rates in the future."

Although Norway's core inflation rate has been unexpectedly mild over the past two months, giving officials some room to observe whether the economy is cooling down, the key drivers of domestic prices, including strong wage growth and a tight labor market, remain solid. In addition, the central bank specifically mentioned that the ongoing conflicts in the Middle East have increased uncertainty about the global inflation outlook.

After the interest rate decision was announced, the Norwegian krone depreciated against the euro by 0.2% to 10.9684. Analysts are divided on whether there will be a final rate hike in September. Danske Bank Chief Economist Jullum believes that the core inflation rate may rise again to above 3% in August, which would force the central bank to take action in September, although this would be a "difficult choice." Currently, traders have slightly reduced their expectations for a rate hike in September.
The Norwegian central bank plans to release new inflation forecasts and policy path reports in September, which will provide more explicit guidance on the direction of interest rates.

items.title: 〈台幣〉聯準會升息機率降 升值7.8分收32.168元
items.title_en: TWD Rises as Fed Rate Hike Probability Decreases, Closes at 32.168
paras: 隨著外資回補台股，台北匯市受到帶動今(13)日續強，新台幣全日處在升值態勢，終場收32.168元，升值7.8分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值較昨日擴大至17.22億美元。
新台幣今日以32.22元、升值2.6分開出後，最高來到32.152元，全日高低價差6.8分。
觀察主要亞幣，以新台幣表現較強勁，收升0.24%，美元指數微跌0.02%左右，日元和人民幣小升0.02%上下，星元微貶不到0.05%，泰銖貶約0.1%，韓元則重挫近0.5%。
國泰證期研究部分析，美國 7 月 CPI 年增率降至 3.4%、核心 CPI 降至 2.5%，通膨降溫，惟服務價格仍具黏性，加上油價逼近 90 美元，能源通膨風險仍在，預期聯準會短期維持利率不變。
群益投顧也表示，美國7月CPI低於6月的3.5%，核心CPI也從6月的2.6%降至2.5%，皆與市場預期一致，儘管仍明顯高於聯準會設定的2%目標，但與6月數據同樣維持平穩，顯示今年稍早由能源價格推動的通膨正在降溫，市場預期9月聯準會升息機率續降。
paras_en: As foreign capital returns to the Taiwanese stock market, the Taipei foreign exchange market was boosted today, with the New Taiwan dollar (TWD) continuing to rise, closing at 32.168, up 7.8 points, and the trading value of the Taipei Foreign Exchange Brokerage Company expanded to $17.22 billion, compared to the previous day.
The TWD opened at 32.22, up 2.6 points, and rose to a high of 32.152 during the day, with a daily high-low price difference of 6.8 points.

Among major Asian currencies, the TWD performed relatively strongly, rising 0.24%, while the US dollar index fell slightly by about 0.02%, the Japanese yen and the Chinese yuan rose slightly by around 0.02%, the Singapore dollar fell by less than 0.05%, the Thai baht fell by about 0.1%, and the Korean won plummeted by nearly 0.5%.

According to Cathay Futures research, the US July CPI annual growth rate fell to 3.4%, and the core CPI fell to 2.5%, indicating a decline in inflation, but service prices still have stickiness, and with oil prices approaching $90, energy inflation risks still exist, and it is expected that the Federal Reserve will maintain interest rates in the short term.

Yuanta Securities Investment Advisory also stated that the US July CPI was lower than June's 3.5%, and the core CPI also fell from June's 2.6% to 2.5%, both of which were in line with market expectations, although they were still significantly higher than the Federal Reserve's 2% target, but remained stable compared to June's data, indicating that the inflation driven by energy prices earlier this year is easing, and the market expects the probability of a Fed rate hike in September to continue to decline.

items.title: 日元走強 高市早苗政府傳支持近期升息
items.title_en: Yen Rises as Kishida Government Said to Support Near-Term Rate Hike
paras: 據知情人士透露，日本首相高市早苗領導的政府目前正轉向支持日本央行(BOJ)於近期升息，預計下一次調升利率的時機最快將落在今年 9 月或 10 月。
這項立場轉變的核心考量在於，日元持續疲軟已推高進口物價並加劇生活成本危機，政府希望透過貨幣政策的配合，強化美日聯合匯率干預的效果。
此消息對市場產生即時衝擊，日元兌美元匯率一度從 159.46 走強至 159.18 附近，日本國債期貨則隨之下跌，基準 10 年期國債殖利率微幅上升。市場目前正密切關注 9 月 18 日的政策會議，交易員預期屆時升息的機率已高達 74%。
高市早苗過去一向被視為對快速升息持保留態度，擔心過早收緊貨幣會扼殺經濟復甦，但在日元貶值引發選民不滿的背景下，政府內部對緊縮政策的容忍度顯著提高。若央行在 12 個月內完成第三次升息，將創下自 1989 年資產泡沫巔峰以來最快的緊縮步調。
雖然日本政府強調尊重央行的法律獨立性，但雙方需就經濟目標保持密切聯繫。日本央行總裁植田和男此前已暗示，面對物價上行的風險，不排除加快升息步伐。
此外，美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)也曾表示，日本央行有必要加入支撐日元的行動。在政府與央行 2013 年簽署的共同協議框架下，雙方正朝著穩定實現 2% 通膨目標的方向協作，這也為近期的政策轉向奠定了政治基礎。
paras_en: According to informed sources, the government led by Japanese Prime Minister Kishida Fumio is now shifting towards supporting the Bank of Japan (BOJ) in raising interest rates in the near term, with the next rate hike expected to occur as early as September or October this year.

The core consideration behind this shift in stance is that the prolonged weakness of the yen has driven up import prices and exacerbated the cost-of-living crisis, and the government hopes to enhance the effectiveness of joint US-Japan currency intervention through monetary policy coordination.

This news has had an immediate impact on the market, with the yen strengthening against the US dollar from 159.46 to around 159.18, and Japanese government bond futures falling, with the benchmark 10-year bond yield rising slightly. The market is closely watching the policy meeting on September 18, with traders expecting a 74% chance of a rate hike at that time.

Kishida Fumio has been seen as cautious about rapid rate hikes in the past, fearing that premature tightening of monetary policy could stifle economic recovery, but in the context of the yen's depreciation triggering voter discontent, the government's tolerance for tightening policies has increased significantly. If the central bank completes its third rate hike within 12 months, it will be the fastest tightening pace since the peak of the asset bubble in 1989.

Although the Japanese government emphasizes respect for the central bank's legal independence, the two sides need to maintain close contact on economic targets. BOJ Governor Ueda Kazuo has previously hinted that, faced with the risk of rising prices, he does not rule out accelerating the pace of rate hikes.

Additionally, US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has also stated that the Bank of Japan needs to join in supporting the yen. Under the joint agreement framework signed by the government and the central bank in 2013, both sides are working together to achieve the 2% inflation target, which has also laid the political foundation for the recent policy shift.

items.title: 美國干預日元反而更危險？《財富》警告市場恐被「大玩家」綁架
items.title_en: Is U.S. Intervention in the Yen More Dangerous? Fortune Warns the Market May Be Hijacked by a “Big Player”
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）與日本財務省聯手干預外匯市場，試圖推動日元升至他眼中「更合理」的水準。然而，這場看似為穩定匯市而來的行動，可能反而釋放出更危險的訊號：當市場開始揣摩政策官員的一言一行，而非依循經濟基本面定價，匯市波動恐怕不減反增。
貝森特先前接受福斯財經網（Fox Business）訪問時直言，日元遭到「嚴重低估」，並認為貨幣「過度波動」並不健康，等同公開質疑市場形成的日元價格。隨著貝森特與日本財務省採取行動，日元隨即走強，但這波升勢究竟能否持續，仍有待觀察。
「大玩家」進場 市場定價邏輯生變
日元走強有兩項主要原因。首先是相關機構直接買進日元；其次，也是影響更大的因素，是貝森特與日本財務大臣片山皋月透過公開發言向市場施壓。兩人均明確表態希望日元升值，並準備透過干預措施支撐疲弱的日元。
《財富》分析指出，這種足以透過言論與行動改變市場走勢的政策人物，是市場中的「大玩家」。「大玩家」最大的特徵，在於其決策不必遵循簡單、明確的規則，而是高度依賴個人判斷。當市場無法預測其下一步行動，政策干預本身就可能成為新的不確定性來源。
歷史教訓：干預可能放大波動
以19世紀俄羅斯的經驗為例。1887年，維什涅格拉茨基（Ivan Vyshnegradsky）出任沙俄財政大臣後，積極操縱盧布兌德國馬克匯率，其干預最終加劇市場波動。繼任者維特（Sergei Witte）則改變方向，放棄裁量式干預，並於1897年推動盧布錨定金本位制。
相關央行干預研究顯示，捍衛貨幣升值與刻意拉高匯率，兩者效果並不相同；相較之下，以明確規則為基礎的制度能降低這類不對稱風險。
換言之，規則提供市場可預測性，而「大玩家」式的裁量干預，反而可能放大波動。
「財政部觀察」恐取代基本面
真正值得警惕的，是貝森特成為外匯市場「大玩家」後可能帶來的連鎖效應。《財富》認為，市場未來可能催生新的「財政部觀察」模式，交易員將緊盯貝森特的每一次發言，逐字解讀他的評論，甚至追逐未經證實的政策傳聞。
一旦這種交易模式形成，真正左右匯率的可能不再只是經濟基本面，而是市場對貝森特下一步行動的猜測，以及對其他交易員猜測的再猜測。
《財富》警告，這將助長羊群效應與噪音交易，使市場參與者把更多精力投入預測政策人物的態度變化，而非分析基本面。
因此，貝森特干預日元真正危險之處，或許不只是日元究竟應該升到什麼價位，而是市場定價機制本身可能發生改變。當交易員開始追逐「大玩家」的一舉一動，政策原本試圖壓低的波動，反而可能因此被進一步放大。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, working together with Japan’s Ministry of Finance, intervened in the foreign‑exchange market in an effort to push the yen up to what he sees as a more reasonable level. Yet this action, which appears aimed at stabilising the market, may actually send a more dangerous signal: when the market starts to read every word and move of policy officials instead of pricing based on economic fundamentals, currency volatility could increase rather than decrease.

In a prior interview with Fox Business, Bessent bluntly said the yen was "severely undervalued" and that its "excessive volatility" was unhealthy, essentially questioning the market‑determined price of the yen. After Bessent and the Japanese finance ministry took action, the yen immediately appreciated, but whether this rally can be sustained remains to be seen.
“Big Player” Enters, Changing Market‑Pricing Logic

The yen’s strength stems from two main drivers. First, the relevant authorities are directly buying yen. Second, and more impactful, is the pressure Bessent and Japanese Finance Minister Shunichi Suzuki apply to the market through public statements. Both have made it clear they want a stronger yen and are prepared to back a weak yen with intervention measures.

Fortune’s analysis points out that policy figures capable of moving markets through words and deeds are the market’s “big players.” The hallmark of a big player is that their decisions do not follow simple, transparent rules but rely heavily on personal judgment. When the market cannot predict their next move, the intervention itself becomes a new source of uncertainty.
Historical Lesson: Intervention Can Amplify Volatility

Take 19th‑century Russia as an example. In 1887, Ivan Vyshnegradsky, as finance minister of the Tsarist regime, actively manipulated the ruble‑to‑German‑mark exchange rate, and his interventions ultimately heightened market volatility. His successor, Sergei Witte, changed course, abandoning discretionary intervention and, in 1897, anchoring the ruble to the gold standard.

Research on central‑bank interventions shows that defending a currency’s appreciation and deliberately pushing a rate higher produce different outcomes; by contrast, rule‑based systems can reduce such asymmetric risks.
In other words, rules give the market predictability, whereas discretionary “big‑player” interventions may actually magnify volatility.
“Treasury Watch” May Supplant Fundamentals

The real danger lies in the chain reaction that could follow Bessent’s emergence as a foreign‑exchange “big player.” Fortune believes the market may give rise to a new “Treasury Watch” paradigm, where traders obsess over every utterance from Bessent, parsing his comments word‑by‑word and even chasing unverified policy rumours.

If such a trading style takes hold, the forces truly moving exchange rates may no longer be economic fundamentals but speculation about Bessent’s next step and the subsequent guesses of other traders about those guesses.

Fortune warns this will fuel herd behaviour and noise trading, causing market participants to devote more energy to forecasting the attitude shifts of policy figures rather than analysing fundamentals.

Thus, the real danger of Bessent’s yen intervention may not be the specific level to which the yen should rise, but the potential alteration of the market‑pricing mechanism itself. When traders start chasing every move of the “big player,” the volatility that policy originally sought to suppress could be amplified further.
